quote: Patterns in primes are a clue to the strong law of small numbers
note: Fortune's conjecture was attributed to Reo Fortune (1903-1979), a New Zealand anthropologist, but was first publicly documented in Martin Gardner's Mathematical Games column in Scientific American, December 1980 (Vol. 243, No. 6). Solomon Golomb's 1981 article in Mathematics Magazine confirmed this and named the Fortunate numbers sequence after Fortune.
